Definition: Tartak, a deity of the Avvites
BiblicalUsage: Tartak was a god of the Avites, one of the peoples settled in Samaria after Israel was carried away. The Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and each nation made gods of their own and put them in the high places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Tartak is a warning in one verse: a people carried away from home brought their gods with them, and the gods stayed false.
